messages:
Ibrahim: Quick heads-up  discovered a deterministic token drift after resuming from a compressed KV snapshot when running the int8 runtime. Prefill and snapshot look fine, but the first 4 tokens after resume diverge vs fp16 baseline.

Seda: Can you paste the exact run and minimal logs?

Ibrahim: run id: kv-snap-resume-1960012345
Command:
```bash
./serve_local --model magnet-13b-qint8 --ctx 131072 --load-snapshot tests/snaps/long_72k_compressed.snap --resume --seed 101
```
Log snippet:
```text
[00:10:01] prefill complete tokens=72000
[00:10:30] snapshot compressed saved; size=42MB
[00:11:05] resume: loaded snapshot; claimed_base=65536
[00:11:06] rotary_apply: incoming_base=65534 applied_offset=65536
[00:11:07] first mismatch @65537 fp16=' the' qint8=' th\n'
```

Lin: That applied_offset/incoming_base mismatch looks like the snapshot header's base_offset is being decoded incorrectly by the compact int decoder in the quant path. Did you try loading the same snapshot on fp16 runtime?

Ibrahim: Yes, fp16 resume is clean. Also reserializing the same snapshot with the uncompressed path and resuming on qint8 returns correct tokens. So root cause narrows to compressed snapshot + qint8 decoder.

Seda: QA Bot, trigger a longcontext smoke with snapshot/resume matrix so we can capture failure modes across sizes. Also, can you add the minimal repro to the onboarding goldset?

QA Bot: Started job longctx-snap-resume-1960012345 (commit f0a1c2). Artifacts: gs://ci-artifacts/longctx/snaps/1960012345/logs.tgz

Lin: Quick mitigation: patch snapshot loader to validate header.base_offset against KV length and fail-fast (fall back to full replay) if mismatch. I'll add a defensive assert and a checksum on the header. Also add a test that compress/decompress roundtrips header fields for the qint8 path.

Seda: For onboarding safety, set Dedicated canaries to disallow compressed snapshots for quantized builds until we land the fix. Also add a CI comparator that resumes from snaps of sizes [64k,65k,72k,120k] and byte-for-byte compares first 256 tokens after resume vs fp16 baseline.

Ibrahim: Minimal repro script: tests/repro/kv_snap_resume_min.py (flags --compress/--no-compress). With --compress + qint8 it fails within 4 tokens consistently. Linking artifact in the CI job.

Ops Bot: Created issue ML-2046 and assigned to eng-ml. Canary rule updated: block compressed-snap restore on quantized runtime until ML-2046 cleared.

Lin: I'll push a small PR to add header checksum + strict header decode for compressed snapshots and a unit test that forces a one-byte truncate corruption to ensure we detect it. If tests pass, we'll canary on dedicated and then flip back.

Seda: Thanks. Please include the minimal repro and the failing snapshot sample in the PR for faster review. Leaving this P0 for onboarding impact. :mag:
